faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What is the interest rate at SMART FUND?
faq.a1: Interest rates at SMART FUND start from 5% per year. The exact rate is determined based on your eligibility profile and chosen tenor during application.
faq.q2: How long does the loan approval process take?
faq.a2: Verification and approval typically take 1-24 business hours after complete documents are received. Funds are disbursed within 1x24 hours after approval.
faq.q3: What are the requirements to apply for a loan?
faq.a3: Main requirements: citizen aged 21-55, valid ID and NPWP, active bank account, steady income, and reachable phone number.
faq.q4: How can I contact customer service?
faq.a4: You can contact our CS via WhatsApp at +62896-7987-5858 or Telegram @cs_smartfund. Available Monday-Saturday 08:00-17:00 WIB.
faq.q5: Are there any hidden fees or upfront administrative fees?
faq.a5: No hidden fees. SMART FUND practices full transparency - all fees (interest, administration, etc.) are explained before you sign the agreement.
faq.q6: How do I withdraw funds after loan approval?
faq.a6: After loan approval and disbursement, you can withdraw via dashboard by filling the withdrawal form. Funds will be sent to your destination bank account.
